title: Swarm Mode
subtitle: Multi-Agent Parallel Execution
infoBanner: Every task you start then builds the subtasks its plan lets run side by side at the same time, each in its own worktree, and merges them into the task's branch after each wave. A subtask whose merge conflicts is left to the task's coder, who builds it afterwards. Works with any LLM provider configured in your account settings.
saveFailed: The swarm setting could not be saved.

config.title: Swarm Configuration
config.maxParallelDesc: Maximum number of agents running simultaneously per wave
config.failFastDesc: Stop the swarm at the first wave where a subtask fails; the task's coder then builds the rest one subtask after the other
